https://polyhaven.com/a/forest_leaves_02

Delivered maps are 512×512 RGB JPEG size/encoding conversions of official 1K
Diffuse and Rough JPG files. Source colors are retained. No generated content,
normal map or displacement map is supplied by this pack. The complete project
includes source images, official API metadata, acquisition/conversion script,
source hashes, runtime hashes and a technical tiling contact sheet under
source-assets/surfaces-v117/.
